output_list.code: function buy() payable returns (uint256 amount){ require(!ico); require(usersCanTrade || canTrade[msg.sender]); amount = msg.value * buyPrice; require(balanceOf[this] >= amount); balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount; balanceOf[this] -= amount; Transfer(this, msg.sender, amount); return amount; }
output_list.reason: If msg.value is large and buyPrice is also large, a buyer can easily buy all tokens by buying them at a discounted price.
